entities.summary: Alexander Gabriel Holtz is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Henderson Silver Knights of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Vegas Golden Knights of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected seventh overall by the New Jersey Devils in the 2020 NHL entry draft.
